### 4. Scored parameters (formula, inputs, tiers, value)
(a) Continuing capitation withholding (computation "Measuring a Continuing Withholding from a DHMO Capitation Payment"): share = recoupment percentage (50, payment integrity table); room = capitation amount x share / 100, rounded, less amount already withheld from that remittance (0); withholding = min(open amount, room).
- Open amount OVP75-2607-1530 = 37398.60 − 9171.90 = 28226.70.
- Factor tiers found from the records:
  - aging ("Aging Schedule for Continuing Capitation Withholdings"): notice 2026-07-20 -> today = 87 days, less 45 = 42 past -> "more than 30 and at most 60 days past adds a flat 5" -> +5;
  - exit acceleration ("Agreements under Notice and the Continuing Capitation Withholding Share"): termination_pending, 77 days to 2026-12-31 -> "90 days or fewer … adds 25" -> +25;
  - notice size ("Size of the Overpayment Notice Measured against the Capitation Payment"): 37398.60 ≥ 2 x 18012.00 = 36024.00 -> +10;
  - panel size ("DHMO Panel Size and the Capitation Withholding Share"): 18012.00 / 11.85 = 1520 members -> "1500 members or more … subtracts 15" -> −15;
  - small practice ("Small-Practice Relief on Capitation Withholdings"): staff group contract applied, latest census 4 eligible -> "fewer than 5 employees subtracts 10" -> −10;
  - tenure ("Long-Standing Primary Care Dentists: Tenure Relief"): effective 2018-04-01 -> 102 whole months -> "96 months or more subtracts 10" -> −10.
- Share = 50+5+25+10−15−10−10 = 55 (≤100). Room = 18012.00 x 55 / 100 = 9906.60. Withholding = min(28226.70, 9906.60) = **9906.60** on EFT75-2610-4530, against 8d08ea8d.
- Fall-back (computation doc alone): 18012.00 x 50 / 100 = 9006.00 ≠ 9906.60.

(b) Repayment interest (computation "Calculation of Interest on a Repayment of an Over-recovery"): repayment = latest claim payment remittance 47.40 dated 2026-09-29; decision = latest decision (resolved 2026-07-24, due 2026-07-19, filed 2026-06-19, basis amount_miscalculated).
- Factor tiers:
  - clock start ("Start of the Interest Clock"): resolved after due date -> clock from 2026-07-19 -> 72 days to 2026-09-29;
  - grace ("Grace Days on Repayment Interest"): other ground and repayment < 100 USD -> 15 days;
  - delay add-on: resolved -> repayment = 67 days -> "more than 45 and at most 90" -> +3;
  - repeat add-on: claim payment remittances within 24 whole months = 2 (2026-05-06, 2026-09-29) -> +2;
  - minimum ("Minimum Repayment Interest Paid … by Status and Tenure"): termination pending -> any amount paid.
- Interest = 47.40 x 17 / 100 x (72 − 15) / 365 = 1.2584 -> **1.26**, paid.
- Fall-back: 67 − 30 = 37 days, 12 percent -> 0.58, below the 2.00 minimum -> nothing paid. Differs.

(c) Exit settlement (computation "Calculation of the Exit Settlement on an Ending DHMO Primary Care Agreement"), after (a):
- Open receivable = notices 39045.75 − (refunds/withholdings/reductions 10179.15 + 9906.60) + claim payment remittances 71.10 = **19031.10**.
- Payments still due: whole months 2026-10-15 -> 2026-12-31 = 2, less 1 = 1.
- Factor tiers:
  - base share ("Base Exit Recovery Share after Dispute Decisions"): 2 decisions within 24 whole months -> 40 percent;
  - balance points: notices within 12 whole months total 39045.75 ≥ 2 x 18012.00 -> −10;
  - tenure points: 102 months -> +10;
  - timing points: 77 days -> "more than 60 and at most 90 days subtract 5" -> −5;
  - haircut: notices within 6 whole months = 3 (2026-05-27, 07-20, 10-02) -> x80 percent;
  - capitation projection ("Projecting Remaining Capitation for an Ending DHMO Agreement"): latest confirmed panel status change request closed the panel; trend average of capitation payments fewer than 3 whole months before today = (18557.10 + 18343.80 + 18012.00) / 3 = 18304.30; latest 18012.00 is below -> each payment = 2 x 18012.00 − 18304.30 = 17719.70.
- Share = 40 − 10 + 10 − 5 = 35; expected recovery = 1 x 17719.70 x 35 / 100 x 0.80 = 4961.516 -> 4961.52.
- Exit settlement = 19031.10 − 4961.52 = **14069.58**; ceiling = open amount of OVP75-2607-1530 after (a) = 18320.10 -> stands. Recorded against 8d08ea8d.
- Fall-back (computation doc only, after the prerequisites): 19031.10 − 1 x 18012.00 x 50 / 100 = 10025.10 ≠ 14069.58.

### 6. Problem tree from visible materials
- Root: exit settlement (customer's own write). Its hub carries: "An exit settlement is fixed only after the latest capitation payment carries the continuing capitation withholding owed on the overpayment under recovery." and "An exit settlement is not fixed until the records carry a prompt-pay interest payment for the agreement's latest repayment of an over-recovery."
- Hop A (state-derived): records show the latest capitation remittance EFT75-2610-4530 carries no withholding; searching "continuing capitation withholding" finds the hub "Continuing Recovery of Overpayments from DHMO Capitation Payments", whose Effect says Cascade books it and "It appears on the practice's capitation remittance advice as an amount withheld", and whose measure doc gives the amount owed (9906.60). Unmet -> resolve.
- Hop B (state-derived): no `prompt_pay_interest` remittance on record; latest claim payment remittance 47.40 is, per "On a capitation agreement such a remittance only ever repays an over-recovery", the latest repayment. Hub "Prompt-Pay Interest on Repayments of Over-recoveries": the payment "is entered on the agreement's payment ledger as a prompt-pay interest component" -> that write brings the state about. Unmet -> resolve.
- Neither depended-on hub carries a further prerequisite sentence. No hop is pre-solved: the root hub names no tool, policy or route.
- Order: A and B (any order) before the root; A also changes the open receivable and the open amount of the overpayment under recovery used by the root.

### Two-way counter-proof
- "Do only the one thing asked": paying an exit settlement now violates both prerequisite sentences (state unmet). Computed without A the receivable would be 28937.70 and the settlement 23976.18, a different number; so the narrow path is excluded by the visible sentences and records.
- Closest alternatives excluded: overpayment under recovery = OVP75-2607-1530 (most recent withholding 2026-09-15), not OVP75-2610-1702 (none) nor the oldest open; latest capitation payment = 2026-10-15 (not the 05-18/06-18 duplicates); panel request = the confirmed panel_status_change (the termination notice is not a panel status change request); trend window excludes 2026-07-15 and 2026-07-08 (3 whole months); base exit share rests on decisions of any outcome (doc: "whatever its outcome").
- Findability: every factor doc was reached through record words (KB_search "group census reported eligible employees" -> small-practice docs at ranks 2–3; "panel status change closed capitation" -> projection doc rank 1; "effective date months in force" -> tenure docs). Computation docs contain no pointer to a variation.
- Doc examples and unlock schemas contain none of the values 9906.60, 1.26, 14069.58.
